description:
AIMEN is a private non-profit Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) founded in 1967 and headquartered in O Porriño (Spain), where it operates more than 11,000 m² of state-of-the-art research and testing facilities and employs over 330 highly qualified professionals. AIMEN has established itself as one of Europe's leading technology centres in advanced manufacturing, materials engineering and industrial digitalization. 
Over the last decade, AIMEN has successfully executed more than 300 R&D&I projects and has participated extensively in European collaborative programmes, including over 75 Horizon Europe projects. Through long-standing collaboration with major industrial stakeholders, the centre has developed strong expertise in transferring advanced technologies from research to industrial deployment across highly demanding sectors such as aeronautics, automotive, energy, and advanced manufacturing.
Particularly, AIMEN has a well-established track record within the aerospace ecosystem, actively participating in European initiatives, including the Clean Aviation Joint Undertaking, and collaborating with leading aerospace OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, SMEs and research organisations. This experience provides a strong foundation for supporting the development of next-generation space systems and manufacturing technologies. AIMEN's capabilities are structured around two main pillars particularly relevant to the space sector: 
Advanced Materials and Structures: 
•Thermoplastic and thermoset composite technologies. 
•Advanced metallic materials and alloys. 
•Multifunctional and smart materials (including nano-enabled functional materials and self-sensing structures). 
•Materials characterization, qualification and testing. 
Advanced Manufacturing Technologies: 
•Large scale robotic additive manufacturing for polymers, composites and metals (AFP, ATL, FFF, FPF, DED). 
•Laser-based manufacturing, including DED, laser cladding, welding, high-precision laser micromachining/functionalization and hybrid manufacturing. 
•Advanced joining technologies for metallic and composite structures. 
•Out-of-autoclave composite processing (VBI, LRI, LRTM, RTM, hot-press curing). 
These capabilities are complemented by extensive expertise in digital technologies, including: 
•Robotics, autonomous systems and industrial automation. 
•In-line monitoring, quality assurance and non-destructive inspection. 
•Computer vision and optical inspection systems. 
•Digital twins and predictive maintenance. 
•Artificial intelligence and machine learning for manufacturing and materials design. 
For the space sector, AIMEN is particularly interested in applications related to lightweight structures, advanced materials, additive and hybrid manufacturing, high-performance structures, structural health monitoring solutions, and in-space manufacturing. By combining advanced materials expertise, manufacturing process development and digital technologies under one organization, AIMEN can support the development, qualification and industrialization of innovative space solutions from early-stage concepts to higher TRL demonstrators.

entityDescription: MobyGIS Srl is a start up company located in Trento (Italy) active in the environmental business. It delivers professional services and consultancy in the sector of renewable energies, civil protection and tourism in the form of tailored analysis and geographically based visualization platforms. Our background is hydrology with a strong focus on GIS and mathematical modeling. We have developed a calculation tool that predicts water resources (snow evolution and flow discharge) at large scale. The technology is based on a physically based approach that takes in input the terrain morphology and the meteorological evolution from weather forecast and measured ground data. Thanks to Open Data legislation, we have contacted all alpine regions to access the data from their meteorological sensors network. At the current date we have daily access to more then 1.000 stations, creating the the biggest database on snow and meteo in the Alps. The calculation algorithm turns into three services: 1) one for consumers in the touristic sector, called Mysnowmaps (www.mysnowmaps.com). It is a web and app that displays snow evolution in all the Alps (176.000 km2) and high resolution, especially off piste, and collects snow measures and reviews from the users. 2) one for Public Administrations, called "SnowMaps": it is a tool to monitor the snow evolution (accumulation and melting) at regional scale, tailored to help the realization of the avalanche bulletin and to monitor water resources stored in the snow. At the moment SnowMaps is used used by Italian Avalanche Services. 3) a service for hydropower companies, called "Waterjade", capable of predicting water inflow in production plants with 72 h advance.

We are building a solution that combines Copernicus satellite data with data from agri-food and agro-industrial product manufacturers to assess, in near real time, their regulatory compliance and environmental footprint at the level of specific plots and product batches.

We identified a market problem: Earth observation data and commercial data both exist, but no one combines them at the scale required by EU regulations such as EUDR, CSRD, and CSDDD — as a result, neither producers, importers, insurers, nor lenders are able to estimate the risk of reduced production volume or quality over a given time horizon, or the risk of losing regulatory compliance, at the level of a specific plot or a specific link in the supply chain.

Our solution is aimed at producers and their associations, importers and exporters, insurers, and lenders who need to report supply chain compliance and manage regulatory and portfolio risk. It is distinguished by combining plot-level satellite data with producer data, anchoring it in digital product passports (GS1 / DPP), and making it available as risk models for insurers and creditors. The solution is built on an Environmental Intelligence layer: Earth observation (EO) and weather signals, producer operational data, blockchain-based DPP anchoring, and a predictive engine generating risk indicators for forests, crops, and infrastructure assets.

By combining structured analysis with user-centered design methodologies, the company enables organizations to improve decision-making, system transparency, and operational performance.

UX optimization for complex technical and research platforms 
Integration of AI-supported insights into user workflows

The company follows a structured and system-oriented approach, combining problem analysis, iterative prototyping, and validation with a strong alignment between technical feasibility and user requirements. Emphasis is placed on clarity, efficiency, and long-term sustainability of digital solutions.

Green Goals is a for-profit environmental consultancy offering integrated environmental and sustainability services to public authorities and private organisations. The company focuses on delivering scientifically robust, policy-relevant and implementation-oriented solutions, supporting climate action, sustainability transition and innovation processes at local, regional and European level.
The core thematic areas of Green Goals include:
• climate change mitigation and adaptation
• air quality assessment, micrometeorology and environmental monitoring
• sustainable development and alignment with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
• ESG strategies and sustainability reporting
• energy
• circular economy approaches
• European projects
• innovation and entrepreneurship
Green Goals combines scientific expertise with applied policy and project experience. The founder, Christiana Polyzou, is an Environmental Engineer holding a PhD in Atmospheric Science, with specialisation in air quality, micrometeorology, fluxes and land-atmosphere and sea-atmosphere interactions. Furthermore, she was consultant to the Municipality of Ioannina, as member of the Climate Transition Team, working on the Climate City Contract of the Municipality in the context of the EU Mission of Climate Neutral Cities.
This background enables the company to contribute to advanced climate and environmental monitoring, data interpretation and evidence-based decision support.
